subject: [PATCH v5 18/19] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness: pageout and compactor. The pageout thread simulates memory pressure by repeatedly advising a region of pages for swap-out, faults them back in, and checks their contents to ensure they remain unchanged after being swapped out. The compactor thread writes to /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory in a loop, competing with the collapse for pages it is gathering. Each combination of mode and occupancy limit is run with and without these threads, testing whether the khugepaged system can handle memory pressure and compaction simultaneously without introducing corruption.
